name: Genial Blocks
author: GenialSouls

sections.description:
Build responsive pages with the native WordPress block editor. Genial Blocks includes 14 customizable Gutenberg blocks and six ready-to-use patterns for layouts, FAQs, pricing tables, carousels, testimonials, statistics, and calls to action—without requiring a separate page builder.

Documentation and Live Demos

Explore the blocks and patterns in action, or follow the step-by-step guides:

  • Documentation
  • Live Block Showcase
  • Patterns Gallery

Why Choose Genial Blocks

Combine responsive layouts, flexible styling, and familiar Gutenberg controls with core blocks to build complete sections.

14 Gutenberg Blocks

Layout and Content

  • Advanced Heading — Semantic H1–H6 headings with optional subtitles.
  • Advanced Button — Styled links with responsive widths and design controls.
  • Container — Responsive wrapper for nested blocks and layouts.
  • Info Box — Content panels with an optional icon and CTA.
  • Icon List — Text lists with bundled icons and optional links.

Interactive Content

  • Accordion — Expandable questions and answers with single or multiple open items.
  • Tabs — Labeled content panels with keyboard navigation.
  • Carousel — Responsive slides with navigation, pagination, and optional autoplay.
  • Countdown — UTC date countdown with a completion message.

Data and Social Proof

  • Counter — Numeric values with optional count-up animation.
  • Progress Bar — Labeled value across a configurable range.
  • Pricing Table — Informational plans, features, and optional CTA; no payment processing.
  • Testimonial — Quote with author details and optional avatar or rating.
  • Team Member — Profile with optional image and social links.

Six Ready-to-Use Patterns

Insert these from the block editor’s Patterns inserter under Genial Blocks, then customize their native blocks and content.

  • Service Hero with CTA — Headline, supporting copy, information panel, and CTA.
  • Three-Service Feature Grid — Three services presented as Info Box cards.
  • FAQ Disclosure — A heading with expandable Accordion answers.
  • Pricing Trio — Three editable informational pricing plans.
  • Stats and Progress — Counters paired with progress indicators.
  • Testimonial and Team CTA — A customer quote with a team profile and optional CTA.

Native Editor and Performance

Built for the WordPress block editor; no separate builder is required. The icon set is bundled locally, with no remote runtime asset service, jQuery, or Slick dependency. Interactive controls use semantic markup and keyboard-aware behavior where applicable. New-tab links receive safe relationship attributes, and Counter and Progress Bar animations respect reduced-motion preferences.

Source Code and Development

Genial Blocks is open-source software. Browse the source and build instructions in the Genial Blocks GitHub repository.

The repository contains human-readable block source in src/, compiled runtime assets in build/, and the build configuration and dependency lockfile used by contributors.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for “Genial Blocks”, or choose Upload Plugin to install a ZIP file.
  3. Activate Genial Blocks.
  4. Open the block inserter and choose a block from the Genial Blocks category.
sections.faq:
Does Genial Blocks require another page builder?

No. Genial Blocks is built for the native WordPress block editor.

Which blocks are included?

Genial Blocks includes Advanced Heading, Advanced Button, Info Box, Accordion, Counter, Icon List, Tabs, Pricing Table, Progress Bar, Container, Testimonial, Team Member, Countdown, and Carousel. Carousel Slide is an internal child block and is not a separate public capability.

Does the Pricing Table process payments?

No. Pricing Table presents plan and pricing information with an optional CTA link. It does not process payments.

Does Genial Blocks require remote runtime assets?

No. The plugin bundles its curated icon set and does not require an external runtime asset service.

Does Genial Blocks support responsive layouts?

Yes. Container provides responsive width, direction, alignment, justification, and gap controls. Advanced Button, Info Box, Pricing Table, and Carousel also provide focused responsive controls.

What are the minimum requirements?

Genial Blocks requires WordPress 6.8 or newer and PHP 7.4 or newer.
sections.changelog:
0.5.0

  • Added six native Gutenberg patterns for common page sections.
  • Improved block discovery with clearer inserter descriptions, keywords, and category metadata.
  • Added a Plugins-screen Getting Started link and contextual Inspector help.
  • Added responsive typography controls for Advanced Heading and responsive alignment, spacing, and width controls for Advanced Button.
  • Improved Tabs mobile scrolling, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, and RTL behavior.
  • Refined accessibility with named Progress Bars, larger Carousel pagination targets, improved default Countdown contrast, and omission of empty Info Box headings.
  • Fixed narrow-screen overflow for full-width Advanced Buttons with padding.

0.4.1

  • Fixed Counter block validation warnings when changing the target value in the WordPress block editor.

0.4.0

  • Added the responsive Basic Carousel with navigation, pagination, autoplay controls, keyboard and touch-friendly behavior, RTL support, and reduced-motion handling.

0.3.0

  • Added Testimonial, Team Member, and Countdown blocks.
  • Fixed Advanced Heading theme compatibility so configured typography and colors apply to the semantic heading element.
  • Fixed responsive Container direction handling.
  • Improved frontend compatibility, validation, and accessible presentation for native block content.

0.2.0

  • Expanded Genial Blocks from two to ten native blocks with eight new blocks: Info Box, Accordion, Counter, Icon List, Tabs, Pricing Table, Progress Bar, and Container.
  • Added a unified Genial Blocks inserter category with distinct block icons.
  • Improved responsive layout behavior, including readable Container content on narrow mobile screens.

0.1.0

  • Initial foundation with Advanced Heading and Advanced Button blocks.
